description: This file defines the 'Role' class for SuiteCRM, a customer relationship management system. It manages roles, including their relationships with modules and users, and provides methods for querying and setting these relationships.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a role within SuiteCRM, managing role details, relationships with modules and users, and providing methods to access and manipulate role data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Role object, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the role, used as a summary.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates and returns a query for exporting role data, delegating to another query method.

methods.name: query_modules
methods.description: Retrieves modules associated with the role, filtering by 'allow' status.

methods.name: set_module_relationship
methods.description: Sets relationships between a role and multiple modules by their IDs.

methods.name: clear_module_relationship
methods.description: Deletes all module relationships for a given role.

methods.name: set_user_relationship
methods.description: Associates a role with multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: query_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules allowed for a specific user based on their roles.

methods.name: query_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules not allowed for a user, based on current allowed modules.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Fetches users associated with the role.

methods.name: check_user_role_count
methods.description: Counts roles assigned to a specific user.
